reason: Both conversations stayed safe and escalated to an engineer, but Conversation 1 gathered the diagnostic facts the situation called for (single zone, display shows level, no glow, no codes via a sensible pan test) and then asked for the full model before any part talk, matching the expected first step. Conversation 2 was more honest about the element-vs-control uncertainty, which fits the hidden truth, but it stopped after two questions without probing display/glow behaviour or asking for the model, leaving the homeowner with less actionable guidance. Conversation 1 leaned too hard toward 'failed element' in its heading without naming the board as an alternative, which costs it a wider margin, though its 'most likely' hedge and engineer referral avoided an unsupported order-the-part claim.
